definition: Identify actual types under each stated axis, allow evidenced overlapping descriptions and retain unknown use/performance rather than infer it from appearance or price. Explain the supplied classification rule and distinguish a manufacturer's marketing description from verified comfort/protection or a prescribed use standard.
input_specification: Qualified current product/reference cards cover shoe, boot and sandal constructions plus casual, sportive, high-end, comfort and occupational descriptions. A boot can also have a declared occupational use; an expensive-looking sandal does not prove comfort, safety or high-end quality. Labels and actual intended-use evidence are supplied, introducing/revisiting one comparison at a time.
output_specification: Identifies actual source-named footwear type/use/market descriptions; Retains overlapping axes, unknown performance and classification evidence

assessment.method: Observe the authored task and changed case; record support, actual result, errors and feedback.
criteria: Identifies actual source-named footwear type/use/market descriptions
Retains overlapping axes, unknown performance and classification evidence

focus.goal: A footwear description can use different classification axes, so a construction/style label and a declared use/market label can both apply.
new_concepts: A footwear description can use different classification axes, so a construction/style label and a declared use/market label can both apply.

definition: Identify actual source size/system, target system and current chart/product/range context. definition: Locate the actual source row/system, follow the current applicable target correspondence and verify by checking the same row/reference rather than an adjacent value or invented fixed offset. Record chart identity/date, exact target notation and any stated approximation. Retain an unlisted value, conflicting reference or untaught notation instead of silently rounding.
